description: List bookings. Use this to see what meetings are scheduled. Returns bookings sorted by start time. Defaults to 10 results. Filter by status or event type to narrow results.

event_type_id.description: Filter by event type ID to see bookings for a specific meeting type

limit.description: Maximum number of bookings to return (default: 10, max: 100)

status.description: Filter by booking status. Omit to include all statuses.

name: list_bookings
